sections.say: Ever fought over who spotted that Vermont plate first?
Plate Chase is a free iPhone game for road trips. Spot license plates from all fifty states and D.C., with family or friends.
See a plate? Tap it. Every state has its own plate, and your ring fills up as you go. Filter by what you still need, or search.
Everyone in the car can play on one phone, each with their own color.
Or play on separate phones. Start a group, text friends the code, and everyone's plates sync through iCloud. You can join as many groups as you like.
Race for the podium, or switch to co-op and fill one shared list as a team.
Made with Swift U.I. and CloudKit. Built by Nikhil Math. Get Plate Chase free on the App Store.
